findings.where: First screen (hero) at both widths, and the whole page: the contact action and the shown address
findings.fault: There is no way to reach Mark anywhere on the page. The first screen has the nav, the name lockup, the line, the paragraph and the portrait, but no contact action and no email address. parts.txt lists no mailto link or contact control at all, and the nav has no Contact item. The palette and texture notes describe a pad-yellow 'address strip' at the foot of the sheet, but nothing like it renders at 1440 or 390.
findings.who_objects: A development-bank or agency officer who has decided Mark may be the advisor they need, and now has no address, link or form to use. The founder would object too: the brief's personal-advisor test needs 'one direct, personal way to reach him', and the hero must hold 'one action with the address shown'. The page's single job, getting in touch, cannot be done.

findings.where: Motion specimen: the 'Replay the entrance' button
findings.fault: It is a button that does something on the page, but it is styled exactly like a prose link: house-blue text with an underline. The palette assigns blue to 'wordmark, links, focus', so this one look now means both 'takes you somewhere' and 'does something here'.
findings.who_objects: A visitor or reviewer who expects the underlined blue text to open a page and gets an animation replay instead. Angélique would also find no distinct button look to copy for later on-page actions. Few would notice on a specimen.

findings.fault: Only this swatch has a house-blue edge, and blue is the colour the palette itself names for focus. The swatch reads as the selected or focused item in a row of choices, though it is static.
findings.who_objects: Someone reading the tile, such as the founder or Angélique, who could take the blue ring to mean this swatch is chosen or clickable, when it is only a sample colour.
